name: CAUTION STOPSIGN
source: Student council president, full-stop danger seeker, full-stop yuri enthusiast. Blessed with the gift to create warm prophecies, and bestowed with a filthy heart that is cursed to machinate-together Crazy Hot Yuri Fantasies. Rebels can be permitted. Crime can be permitted. Everything can be permitted for the creation of Yuri. Full-stop.
